title: [Navigation] Has Real Entity
description: Checks if one or more fakes navigations are using real entities.
syntax_pattern:
%navigations% (has|have) a real entity
%navigations% (has|have)(n't| not) a real entity

title: [Display] Block Data
description: Gets or sets the block data string of a block display entity. Only works on DisplayData instances that are of the BlockDisplay type.

title: [Voice] Has VoiceChat
description: Checks if one or more players are currently connected and using the voice module.

title: [Voice] Phrase Detected
description: Fires when a voice phrase is recognized by Vosk for a player.
event_values:
on voice phrase detected:,
         broadcast "%player% said: %event-string%"

title: [Display] Item
description: Gets or sets the item displayed by an item display entity. Only works on DisplayData instances of the ItemDisplay type. Accepts ItemType or ItemStack on set.

title: Body Yaw
description: Gets the body yaw rotation of an entity.

title: [Display] Create Group
description: Creates a new fake display group anchored at a location or attached to an entity. Optionally takes a list of display datas to populate the group with, and a list of players who will see it. Both are optional and can be combined freely.

title: [Display] Destroy Group
description: Destroys one or more fake display entity groups, removing them from all targeted players via packets.

title: [Display] Set Group Direction
description: Orients a display group toward a specific direction by setting its yaw and pitch values directly.

title: [Display] Set Group Rotation
description: Sets the full 3D rotation of a display group using Euler angles (X, Y, Z in degrees). Internally converts to a quaternion using JOML's rotationXYZ method.

title: [Display] Mount Group
description: Mounts or dismounts fake display groups or cosmetics onto entities or virtual entity IDs. Supports four patterns: simple self-mount, mount on a real entity, mount on a virtual ID at a location, and packet-based mount/dismount for specific players.
syntax_pattern:
make fake %displaygroups/cosmetiques% mount
make fake %displaygroups% mount on %entity%
make fake %displaygroups% mount on %integer% at %location%
make fake %entities/integers% [(dis)]mount on %entity/integer% for %players%

title: [Display] Mirror Transformation
description: Applies a mirror (axis flip) transformation to one or more display entities or display groups. Axes can be combined freely: X, Y, Z, XY, XZ, YZ, or XYZ.

title: [Cosmetic] Destroy
description: Fully destroys one or more cosmetics and removes them from all targeted players. Calls the internal delete method on each cosmetic object.

title: [Cosmetic] Delete Part
description: Removes a specific part (hat, back, or tail) from a cosmetic. The hat pattern supports an optional slot identifier to remove only a specific hat layer.
syntax_pattern:
(delete|remove) [the] hat of %cosmetique% [(in [slot] %string%)]
(delete|remove) [the] back of %cosmetique%
(delete|remove) [the] tail of %cosmetique%

title: [Display] Send Metadata Update
description: Forces a metadata packet update for a display group or a cosmetic, pushing the latest state to all relevant players.

title: [Cosmetic] Set Part
description: Sets or replaces a specific part of a cosmetic: a hat (linked to a display group, a slot name, and rotation flags), a back (linked to a display group and a type string), or a tail (linked to a tail node).
syntax_pattern:
set hat of %cosmetique% to %displaygroup% in [slot] %string% with [[vertical] rot[ation]] %boolean%[[,] [and] [[horizontal] rot[ation]]] %boolean%
set back of %cosmetique% to %displaygroup% [with type] %string%
set tail of %cosmetique% to %tailpart%

title: [Cosmetic] Set Tail Rotation
description: Sets the rest rotations for all segments of a cosmetic's tail by providing a list of Quaternionf values. Each quaternion corresponds to one tail segment, iterated in depth-first order (DFS).

title: [Cosmetic] Scale
description: Gets or sets the uniform scale factor of a cosmetic. The scale is applied to all parts of the cosmetic (hats, back, tail).

title: [Cosmetic] Self Visibility
description: Gets or sets whether the player wearing the cosmetic can see their own hat, back, or tail parts. Useful for hiding first-person overlapping cosmetics like masks or helmets.

title: [Cosmetic] Create
description: Creates a new cosmetic data object attached to an entity or player. When targeting a player, three booleans enable or disable the hat, back, and tail slots respectively. Non-player entities always have all three slots disabled.

title: [Cosmetic] Create Tail Part
description: Creates a new tail node linked to a display group with a positional offset. Optionally connects it to a parent tail node to build a chain. If no parent is provided, the node becomes the root of a new tail structure.
syntax_pattern: [a] [new] tail[ ]part from %displaygroup% with offset %vector% [[,] [connected] to parent %tailpart%]

title: Entity Trackers
description: Gets a list of all players who are currently tracking (seeing) a specific entity.

title: Future Direction
description: Calculates the future direction or position of an entity based on its current velocity.
syntax_pattern:
[the] predicted yaw of %player%
[the] predicted pitch of %player%

title: Generate ID
description: Generates a random unique identifier (ID).

title: Split with Regex
description: Splits a text into multiple parts using a regular expression (Regex).

title: Tracked Entities
description: Gets a list of all entities currently being tracked (seen) by a specific player.

title: [Display] Data
description: Base type representing a fake display entity. Can be a block, item, or text display. Cannot be parsed from text — instances are created via the dedicated section syntax for each subtype.
type_usage: Created via 'set %objects% to a new fake block/item/text display'.

title: [Display] Block
description: A fake display entity that renders a block. Supports all common display properties (scale, translation, rotations, glow, shadow, view range, billboard) plus a block data string that defines which block is shown. Fully serializable for persistent storage in Skript variables.
type_usage: Created via 'set %objects% to a new fake block display'.

title: [Display] Text Content
description: Gets, sets, or appends to the text content of a text display entity. Only works on DisplayData instances of the TextDisplay type. Supports SET and ADD change modes.

title: [Display] Rotation
description: Gets or sets the left or right rotation quaternion of a fake display entity. Both rotations are represented as Quat4 objects and affect how the display is oriented in the world.
syntax_pattern:
[the] left rotation of %displaydata%
[the] right rotation of %displaydata%

title: [Display] Scale / Translation
description: Gets or sets the scale vector or translation offset of a fake display entity. Scale controls the size on each axis; translation offsets the display relative to its anchor point.
syntax_pattern:
[the] group scale of %displaydata%
[the] group translation of %displaydata%

title: [Display] See Through
description: Gets or sets the see-through property of a text display entity. When true, the text is visible through blocks. Only works on DisplayData instances of the TextDisplay type.

title: [Display] Displays of Group
description: Gets, adds, or removes the display entities contained in a display group. Supports ADD, REMOVE, and REMOVE_ALL change modes.

title: [Display] Group Viewers
description: Gets, sets, adds, or removes the players who can see a display group or a cosmetic. Supports SET, ADD, REMOVE, and REMOVE_ALL change modes.

title: [Display] Group Transformation
description: Gets or sets the center, translation, rotation, or scale of a display group. Center and translation return a Vector; rotation returns a Quaternionf; scale returns a Number.
syntax_pattern:
[the] group center of %displaygroup%
[the] group translation of %displaygroup%
[the] group rotation of %displaygroup%
[the] group scale of %displaygroup%

title: [Display] Group Location
description: Gets or sets the current location of a fake display group. Setting the location will teleport the group to the new position.

title: [Voice] Rules
description: Gets, sets, adds or removes voice recognition rules (phrases) for a specific player.

title: [Cosmetic] Cosmetic
description: A cosmetic object that groups hat, back, and tail parts for a specific entity or player. All parts share a common mount and scale. Cannot be parsed from text.
type_usage: Created via 'a new cosmetique for %entity%' or 'a new cosmetique for %player% with hats %boolean% back %boolean% and tail %boolean%'.

title: [Display] Group
description: A group of fake display entities (item, block, or text displays) that share a common location or attached entity, and are sent to specific players via packets. Supports transformation, rotation, mirroring, mounting, and viewer management. Can be serialized and restored across reloads when attached to a location.
type_usage: Created via 'a new fake display group at %location/entity%', optionally with displays and players.

title: [Display] Create Fake Block
description: Creates a new fake block display entity using a configuration section. Accepted keys: block (ItemType, ItemStack, BlockData, Material, or String block data), scale/translation (Vector or Number), rotation/leftrotation/rightrotation (Quaternionf), glow (int RGB), shadow/shadowradius/radius, strength/shadowstrength, range/viewrange, billboard (0–3), interpolation/interpolationduration, interpolationstart/interpolationdelay (Number).

title: [Display] Create Fake Item
description: Creates a new fake item display entity using a configuration section. Accepted keys: item/itemstack/material (ItemType, ItemStack, or Material), head (String — sets item to PLAYER_HEAD and applies the skin value; mutually exclusive with item), mode/displaymode (none/thirdperson_lefthand/thirdperson_righthand/firstperson_lefthand/firstperson_righthand/head/gui/ground/fixed, or 0–8), scale/translation (Vector or Number), rotation/leftrotation/rightrotation (Quaternionf), glow (int RGB), shadow/shadowradius/radius, strength/shadowstrength, range/viewrange, billboard (0–3), interpolation/interpolationduration, interpolationstart/interpolationdelay (Number).

title: [Display] Create Fake Text
description: Creates a new fake text display entity using a configuration section. Accepted keys: text (String), seethrough/see_through/through (Boolean), alignment/align/textalignment (center/left/right or 0/1/2), background/backgroundcolor/bgcolor (Color, int RGB, or hex string), linewidth/width/line_width (Number), scale/translation (Vector or Number), rotation/leftrotation/rightrotation (Quaternionf), glow (int RGB), shadow/shadowradius/radius, strength/shadowstrength, range/viewrange, billboard (0–3), interpolation/interpolationduration, interpolationstart/interpolationdelay (Number).

title: [Display] Item
description: A fake display entity that renders an item or block item model. Supports all common display properties (scale, translation, rotations, glow, shadow, view range, billboard) plus an item stack identifier and a display mode (none/thirdperson/firstperson/head/gui/ground/fixed). Also supports player head skin values via the 'head' key. Fully serializable for persistent storage in Skript variables.
type_usage: Created via 'set %objects% to a new fake item display'.

title: [Display] Text
description: A fake display entity that renders formatted text. Supports all common display properties (scale, translation, rotations, glow, shadow, view range, billboard) plus text content, background color, text alignment (center/left/right), line width, and see-through mode. Fully serializable for persistent storage in Skript variables.
type_usage: Created via 'set %objects% to a new fake text display'.

title: [Cosmetic] Tail Part
description: Represents a single segment (node) in an animated tail structure. Nodes are chained together from a root node outward; each node references a display group and a positional offset. Cannot be parsed from text and is not persistently serializable.
type_usage: Created via 'a new tailpart from %displaygroup% with offset %vector%', optionally connected to a parent tail part.

title: [Navigation] Destroy Navigation
description: Destroys one or more navigation instances, removing them from the global tick registry. Once destroyed, the navigating object stops moving and its tick() method will no longer be called. Always destroy navigation instances when they are no longer needed to avoid memory leaks.

title: Entity ID
description: Gets the ID of a specific entity.

title: [Navigation] Creation
description: Creates a new navigation object. Can be created from a numeric entity ID or a real entity. Requires a hitbox vector (width/height), a starting location, and a movement type string (WALK, FLY, SWIM). Speed and a viewer list are both optional.
syntax_pattern:
[a] [new] navigation with id %number% hitbox %vector% location %location% type %string% [speed %number%] [with players %players%]
[a] [new] navigation with entity %entity% type %string% [speed %number%] [with players %players%]

title: [Navigation] Entity
description: Returns the real Bukkit entity attached to a navigation object. Returns nothing if the fake navigation was created from a numeric ID rather than a real entity.

title: [Navigation] Hitbox
description: Gets or sets the hitbox vector of a navigation object. The vector defines the collision size used during pathfinding (X = width, Y = height, Z = depth).

title: [Navigation] Location / Destination
description: Gets or sets the current location or the movement destination of a navigation object.
syntax_pattern:
[fake] location of navigation %navigation%
[fake] destination of navigation %navigation%

title: [Navigation] Numeric Properties
description: Gets or sets numeric properties of a navigation object: movement speed, pause duration in ticks, or the numeric entity ID (read-only).
syntax_pattern:
[fake] speed of navigation %navigation%
[fake] pause ticks of navigation %navigation%
[fake] entity id of navigation %navigation%

title: [Navigation] Pathfinding Type
description: Gets or sets the movement type of a navigation object as a string. Valid values are WALK, FLY, and SWIM. Invalid values are silently ignored and the type remains unchanged.

title: [Navigation] Viewers
description: Gets, adds, removes, or replaces the list of players who can see the (fake) entity fake navigating. Supports SET, ADD, and REMOVE change modes via dedicated syntax patterns.

title: [Navigation] Type
description: A virtual pathfinding entity controlled via packets (for fake entities) or the Bukkit API (for real entities). Computes an A* path toward a destination each tick, supporting multiple movement types: WALK, WALK_WATER, SWIM, FLY, FLY_GROUND, CLIMB, and NONE. When created from a real entity, movement is applied directly via teleport without requiring PacketEvents. When created from a numeric ID, PacketEvents is required to send movement packets to viewers.
type_usage: Created via 'a new fake navigation with id %number% ...' or 'a new navigation with entity %entity% ...'.

title: [Display] Clone
description: Clones one or more display datas or display groups, optionally applying a mirror transformation on one or more axes during cloning. Without an axis, produces an exact copy.

title: [Display] Entity ID / UUID
description: Returns the numeric entity ID or the UUID string of a fake display entity. The entity ID is used for packet operations; the UUID is used for persistent identification.
syntax_pattern:
[the] entity id of %displaydata%
[the] entity uuid of %displaydata%

title: [Display] From Real Entity
description: Converts a real Bukkit display entity (BlockDisplay, ItemDisplay, or TextDisplay) into a fake DisplayData object that can be used in display groups and cosmetics.

title: [Display] Numeric Properties
description: Gets or sets any numeric property of a display entity: glow color, shadow radius, shadow strength, view range, billboard mode (all types), display mode (item display only), background color, text alignment, and line width (text display only).
syntax_pattern:
[the] glow [color] of %displaydata%
[the] shadow radius of %displaydata%
[the] shadow strength of %displaydata%
[the] view range of %displaydata%
[the] billboard [mode] of %displaydata%
[the] display mode of %displaydata%
[the] background color of %displaydata%
[the] text alignment of %displaydata%
[the] line width of %displaydata%

title: [Cosmetic] Tail Physics
description: Gets or sets any numeric physics or motion parameter of a cosmetic tail. All 19 parameters are individually accessible: rigidity, damping, velocity smoothing, velocity influences (forward/lateral/vertical/yaw), max deflection angle, depth deflection factor, impulse influences (forward/lateral/vertical), undulation amplitudes (x/y/z), undulation frequency and propagation, and random motion amplitude and frequency.
syntax_pattern:
tail rigidity of %cosmetique%
tail damping of %cosmetique%
tail velocity smoothing of %cosmetique%
tail velocity [influence] forward of %cosmetique%
tail velocity [influence] lateral of %cosmetique%
tail velocity [influence] vertical of %cosmetique%
tail velocity [influence] yaw of %cosmetique%
tail max deflection angle of %cosmetique%
tail depth deflection factor of %cosmetique%
tail impulse [influence] forward of %cosmetique%
tail impulse [influence] lateral of %cosmetique%
tail impulse [influence] vertical of %cosmetique%
tail undulation [amplitude] x of %cosmetique%
tail undulation [amplitude] y of %cosmetique%
tail undulation [amplitude] z of %cosmetique%
tail undulation frequency of %cosmetique%
tail undulation propagation of %cosmetique%
tail random [amplitude] of %cosmetique%
tail random frequency of %cosmetique%
